components.css: .ds-spec{display:grid;gap:.15rem;padding:.6rem;color:#1c2a21;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent}.ds-spec:hover{border-color:#b7c6aa}.ds-spec .f{font-family:"Bodoni Moda",serif;font-style:italic;color:#a4471f}.ds-spec .a{aspect-ratio:1;border:1px dashed #b7c6aa}.ds-spec b{font-family:"Bodoni Moda",serif}.ds-spec i{font-family:"Bodoni Moda",serif;color:#3c4c40}

components.name: Ruled Field
components.description: Underline field like an inspection slip.

narrative.overview: The page is a plate from a naturalist field guide: sage plate paper, forest ink, hairline double frames, and rust reserved for figure numbers and the report action. Specimens are figures with numbers and Latin names; the guide entries below are the plate legend. The visitor finds the creature they saw and reports it.

rules.name: The Rust Mark Rule
rules.body: Rust (#a4471f) marks figure numbers, the selected specimen and the report action. It never fills large areas.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: Every specimen on the plate has a matching entry with Signs, How urgent and What the technician does, linked by its figure number.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No shadows. Depth comes from hairline frames (1px and 0.5px ink) and paper tone shifts.

dos: Do keep the primary action color for the send or report action only.
donts: Don't add TropiFix branding or link to the sister sites.
